items.title: Andy Anderson Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Handy took me off the Pelican. He played the La Vida dance hall, the taxi dance.

ctx.x: Clarence Todd had made some records of Clarence Williams, that's what I'm trying to think of, a singer too, did he sing?

Clarence Todd, he did. That's the same song. We can talk to Camilla sometime. Yeah, he was, not so very long ago he was there, you know. Camilla lives uptown. And I also, for Alvin, I got Lois Domain, you know, Lois, I knew you know what it was. I got Lois Domain, what he said then, you know. Well after he sat in the band and taught me, because he used to coach me and tell me a lot of things, he can mention, valuable ideas about the trumpet, little tricks about the trumpet, you know. So after he sat in the band,…

He kind of hoity so, but he broke his own. And well the people know the Budweiser back and at least they want to sue the Budweiser people. So they backed out. See they had to go back to the front and they pulled out the interciser out of there. And after they played there about a few years, I can show you some words that a fella, we call him Mestedi. I don't know if you know him, he loved dances. A fella, he even reminded me of Mestedi. He used to come and that man would stand inside the band stand and he'd clap…

items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: I think Andy Anderson was talking about that.

ctx.x: They would often come down there with me, out to La Vida. Well, I think John, uh, Lee Collins and John Marrero left for, uh, left, uh, a tenor player there. Yeah, they went to Chicago and left him there. And they went to Chicago and left him there. And David Jones stayed there with me a long time. As a matter of fact, he opened up, uh, a teacher school uptown here somewhere. here some way. Alfred Williams stayed there a long time. Jim Robinson stayed there a long time. But uh, Alfred left and went to Texas. And…
Is that the sort of Mexican looking fella? Yeah, yeah, that's him. I think Andy Anderson was talking about that.
